correctness.rationale: The prey equations of a positive prime-2 orbit force 0<a<b<1 and give uniquely positive v1=(1+ca)(2-a-b/a) and v2=(1+cb)(2-b-a/b). Their exact difference is (b-a)[a+b-ab+abc(3-a-b)]/(ab)>0. Thus predator multiplier R(a)=k>1 and R(b)=1/k<1 force q=theta/beta>[(1+ca)(1+cb)]^-1>(1+c)^-2; R(a)>1,r>0 force q<(1+ca)^-1<1. For every interior q pick z=1+ca in (q^-1/2, min(1+c,q^-1)), then sufficiently close b>a; beta=(k-k^-1)/((b-a)(q-[(1+ca)(1+cb)]^-1))>0 and r=1-k+a beta((1+ca)^-1-q)>0 as b->a. All four orbit equations follow exactly; boundary strictness is proved. A rational witness at c=1,q=1/2 was independently checked.
